6syo: The general aim of the Bachelor of Accounting is to provide the formal educational requirements for students in order that they may function competently in the accounting professional, specialist and managerial positions in private or public practice, commerce, industry and the public sector.

Ready to help shape the rapidly evolving and growing agricultural industry? The Bachelor of Agricultural Business Management from Charles Sturt University combines study in agricultural production and science with a variety of business disciplines, preparing students for entrepreneurial, management and leadership roles in the agricultural sector.

As the agricultural industry undergoes rapid transformation, agribusiness companies, including the major banks, are seeking employees skilled in business, management and finance, and who have technical agricultural training. There is also increasing demand for better-trained managers of large agricultural enterprises.
1zji:
Program Description

Develop knowledge and skills in animal production, management and welfare across a range of domestic and wildlife animal species with the Bachelor of Animal Science from Charles Sturt University. Students will receive comprehensive training and practical experience to prepare them for a career working with animals or in animal-related industries.

This degree could take students anywhere in Australia or the world – from animal production enterprises and ancillary industries, to education or advisory roles; working in research laboratories and in the field; or in management and conservation in a wide range of habitats, enterprises and organisations (e.g. zoos) across the globe.
6syv:
The Bachelor of Business from Charles Sturt University Sydney blends foundational business studies with contemporary theory in the fields of either Management, Marketing, Human Resource Management, Finance or Strategic Planning and current industry practice to prepare students for general and specialist careers in their chosen fields.

When students study finance as a major, they'll develop a broad range of skills that will enable them to make their mark in local, national or global companies. Students will be work-ready in roles within business development, banking, insurance and all levels of government.
6sz1:
The Bachelor of Information Technology with specialisations at Charles Sturt University Sydney gives students a comprehensive understanding of fields across the entire IT industry. They can also choose to specialise in an area that fires their imagination and fits their career goals.

This specialisation is for the students who are interested in computer programming, and software and application development. The specialisation begins with the basic programming principles and then discusses the advanced professional programming concepts for the production of quality software. Students taking this specialisation also learn fundamental mobile applications development concepts.
1zit:
Program Description

Medical radiation science is a diverse, challenging and progressive field that combines science, health and anatomy/physiology. The Bachelor of Medical Radiation Science from Charles Sturt University offers students the theoretical knowledge and professional skills to practise as a qualified medical radiation scientist. Taught by industry-based professionals, this degree has a high success rate in industry employment.

Students can also choose to specialise in one of three areas: nuclear medicine and molecular imaging, diagnostic radiography, or radiation therapy. They will enrol directly into their specialisation, but build a strong foundation of core knowledge in their first year.
1zhm:
Program Description

The Bachelor of Nursing from Charles Sturt University has led the way for nurses for more than 30 years. Our undergraduate students are part of the university’s strong and proud nursing tradition, joining the ranks of Charles Sturt University graduates across Australia who are known for their resilience, versatility and adaptability.
1zil:
Program Description

As a first-line responder in the most critical of circumstances, students will experience a dynamic and highly rewarding career that makes a profound difference to people's lives. This course is one of the few dedicated paramedicine degrees in New South Wales carrying full accreditation with the Council of Ambulance Authorities. It can take students from outback Australia to the heart of London, and many places in between.
1zig:
Program Description

Passionate about physical health and wellbeing? Looking for a rewarding career helping people to feel their best? With a proud history spanning two decades, the Bachelor of Physiotherapy from Charles Sturt University has a reputation for producing highly sought-after graduates who have gone on to launch successful physiotherapy careers in Australia and overseas.

Physiotherapists help to maintain or restore movement and function in people who are affected by injury, illness or disability. As experts in movement, they play a key role in promoting health, independence and quality of life for people of all ages.
7tdy:
This Master of Agricultural Science program from Charles Sturt University will redirect or enhance students' capabilities for a diverse career in the agricultural, agribusiness, or sustainability sectors.

They will be prepared for leadership roles in policy, research, and strategic management in a wide range of industry contexts.
7tdx:
This Master of Agriculture program will develop student's expertise in natural resources and human and economic factors that impact agricultural sustainability.

The course consists of four core subjects, a specialization, and 32 points of restrictive elective subjects. Students can complete a standard Master course rather than a specialization by selecting an additional 32 points of restricted elective subjects. They will choose their specialization from agricultural business management, digital agriculture, and sustainable agriculture

Students will get master’s qualified in as little as one and a half years

9byi:
The Master of Health Professional Practice (with specialisations) is a postgraduate program designed for health professionals seeking to advance their knowledge, skills, and leadership capabilities within their field. Offered by Charles Sturt University, the course provides flexible learning options and allows students to tailor their studies through a range of specialisations relevant to contemporary healthcare practice.

The program focuses on enhancing professional practice through evidence-based learning, critical thinking, and applied research. Students engage with topics such as healthcare leadership, clinical education, service improvement, and professional development. The course is suitable for practitioners from diverse health backgrounds who wish to expand their expertise, improve patient outcomes, and take on advanced or leadership roles within healthcare settings.

Graduates of the program are equipped with the skills required to respond to evolving healthcare challenges and contribute effectively to multidisciplinary environments.
9fhq:
The Master of Nursing (Pre-registration) is designed for graduates from non-nursing disciplines who wish to enter the nursing profession. The programme combines nursing theory, clinical skills development, evidence-based practice, and supervised professional placements to prepare students to provide safe, person-centred care in diverse healthcare environments.

Areas of study may include anatomy and physiology, health assessment, clinical nursing practice, pharmacology and medication safety, acute and chronic care, mental health, community health, Indigenous health, research, healthcare leadership, and professional and ethical practice. Simulation activities and clinical placements allow students to apply theoretical knowledge while developing communication, critical-thinking, teamwork, and clinical decision-making skills.

Graduates may be eligible to apply for registration as a nurse in Australia, subject to the programme’s accreditation and meeting all requirements of the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Australia (NMBA) and the Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (Ahpra). Clinical placements may require immunisation evidence, police and working-with-children checks, first-aid certification, and other compliance documents. Exact modules, placement arrangements, accreditation status, and registration outcomes should be confirmed with the university.
7c2w:
The Master of Professional Accounting (Professional Practice) aims to provide the formal educational requirements for entry to the profession of Accounting, and the opportunity to develop key professional and employability skills which can then be applied in practice through a work placement in industry.

The degree is designed to build upon previous non-accounting undergraduate studies to provide graduates with relevant technical and theoretical knowledge of accounting and related disciplines. The program integrates professional communication skills, computer applications, and business ethics within the discipline of accounting. Through a series of work integrated learning activities, including a work placement, the course will prepare students for careers as professional accounting practitioners, for specialist and managerial positions in private or public practice, commerce, industry and the public sector.

For each 8-point subject students are enrolled in, they should expect to spend 10 to 12 hours per week working on assignments and assigned readings, tutorial assistance, individual or group research/study, forum activity, workplace learning, and attending lectures, intensive schools, or examinations. If they are studying four subjects per session, this is equivalent to a full-time job. The workload for some subjects may vary as a result of approved course design.

Students enrolled at Charles Sturt University Melbourne will complete structured work integrated learning activities as part of their program of study. The opportunity to undertake work placement may be available for students contingent on satisfactory progression and grades.

The aim of the Master of Project Management and Leadership (Professional Practice) course is to prepare students with the project management, leadership and communication skills needed to successfully plan, manage and lead the delivery of an enterprise project using traditional and contemporary approaches.

The course will develop students’ people skills relating to leadership, communication, stakeholder management and change facilitation alongside the technical skills of risk management, project plan development, project lifecycle, and project funding. The course will build students’ capacity to apply these skills in a professional context through a series of structured work integrated learning activities and/or a work placement opportunity.
8zyk: The Master of Social Work – Professional Qualifying (119188F) aims to provide a two-year postgraduate social work program delivered by distance education that leads to professional accreditation with the Australian Association of Social Workers (AASW). It seeks to produce qualified social workers to help address the national shortage in rural and regional Australia, while also making the profession accessible to students who are unable to undertake full-time, on-campus study at metropolitan universities. Additionally, the program is designed to develop graduates who are dedicated to promoting social justice, human rights, and thriving communities at regional, national, and international levels through education, research, ethical practice, and partnerships.
